titleStmt.title: Thomas Carlyle Photograph Albums, Album Five

publicationStmt.p: Alternative title is Tales of the Sun, 1855
Electronic reproduction. New York, N.Y.: Columbia University Libraries, 2018.

sourceDesc.p: Original album forms part of the Thomas Carlyle Papers Collection at Columbia University Rare Book and Manuscript Library

div.p: An assorted array, many pictures from TC and JWC’s era including material possibly removed from their portrait screens, other portraits and views collected, assembled, and arranged by Alexander Carlyle / this album contains 38 images
